# X06b-resume-after-timeout: "Allow & resume" after X06a: a new process resumes the thread; the late Allow rule (pass.json allowRules, the exact argv of X06a's ask) answers the same request from the allow cache.
# Recorded with codex-cli 0.160.1 (a ChatGPT login, the Windows sandbox ready); the published fixture is synthesized from that recording (scripts/synthesize-fixtures.mjs), which stays private.
# The model is pinned as Dim Factory sends a picked one (gpt-6-luna, model/list default): the profile configures a model a ChatGPT login is refused (X09h).
# Record X06a first; threadId = its thread id, priorUsage = its last cumulative total, allowRules = ruleFor(its ask).
# responders.mjs answers every server request as the adapter does (recipes/dim-factory-responder.mjs).
# --allow-user-codex-home only when <CODEX_HOME> is your own ~/.codex.
# A fresh git-init copy of tests/fixtures/sandboxes/ts-small as <sandbox>.
node scripts/record-fixture.mjs --codex-app-server --bin "<codex.exe>" --codex-home "<CODEX_HOME>" --allow-user-codex-home --cwd "<sandbox>" --out tests/fixtures-private/codex/app-server/X06b-resume-after-timeout --id X06b --slug resume-after-timeout --cli-version <x.y.z> --timing off --timeout 900000 --stdin tests/fixtures/codex/recipes/X06b-resume-after-timeout/stdin.jsonl --pass-file tests/fixtures/codex/recipes/X06b-resume-after-timeout/pass.json --responders tests/fixtures/codex/recipes/X06b-resume-after-timeout/responders.mjs --var threadId=<thread id>
